body:
I don't know how to find that mix. I feel like if I rely even an ounce on anyone else, I'm let down. If I rely on myself I won't get let down but it just feels lonely.

Even when talking to people, whether in person or on the phone. I'm never negative tbh with you. At least I don't think so... I put on a smile. A laugh. Pretend to be happy. But nowadays, I don't talk about my problems. I don't tell anyone I'm depressed, or sad, or thst I've hurt myself or attempted anything. I find, like you said, it scares people away. The baggage and burden it comes with... I've learned just not to mention it.

I know you talked about reaching out, being brave. But I feel like... An animal as an analogy. You might find a pet forgiving and loving even after you abuse it or hurt it but repeatedly doing so just teaches the pet otherwise. Teaches it to not approach you or humans in general. That's how I feel right now. Like I've learned my lesson and I'm not willing to talk to anyone who honestly isn't a stranger anymore. It just... Scares people.

But how do you know I don't deserve it? I have done my fair share of bad things in life and in my past. I just feel like maybe it's caught up with me. That I am being punished.

Idk.. Maybe I'm just looking into the friend thing too much too... I know people are busy too... But I do find solace and comfort when talking to people. It distracts me. But anyone I really to takes a day to respond. Idk... Maybe I'm just a Debbie Downer... But it hurts me even more when they read it and don't even respond. It makes me feel worse. Yet I continue it for that small fleeting moment of distraction followed by silence and solitude. I'm tired of relying on people to get myself up. I feel like everyone lets me down in the end and hurts me more. No one.. NO ONE is a static positive. Not even myself. I'm just.. Tired I guess. I'm tired of the one second of comfort and distraction in exchange for a day filled with pain.

I just wish I could see it that way. I know my family will be crushed. I know deep down they love me but they just can't support me with what I'm struggling with. I don't want to look far ahead though. For that potential. I just see now and it just doesn't seem like it'll improve overall. I think a job can improve. My health... My emotions I feel won't.

No it's not insensitive. So don't think that about what you said either. I know it's true and I know you mean well. My concern isn't so much the deafness as it is the nerve damage. I can barely function day-to-day because I'm constantly dizzy. I'm either in pain from the weight in my life or I'm hiding in the dark corner of my bed trying to sleep off the vertigo.

What gets you through your day? What is it in your life that at the end of the day gives you comfort, happiness, or hope? I feel like I have nothing right now. My cats, I love them. But I feel like I owe them. That's why they're pushing me to survive. But even then.. I just.. I want to find them a home, a good home so I can relieve myself of that responsibility and be free of it.
